origin.summary: An event from the 2023 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A one-rep-max snatch and clean and jerk test, each contested in fast, short lifting windows.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2023/9 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; score is the combined total of best snatch + best clean and jerk
